title_en: In Vasil Shanto, 2+1 apartment for sale, ideal for living!!!
description_en: In Vasil Shanto, 2+1 Apartment for Sale, Ideal for Living with ample spaces. The apartment is located on the 2nd floor of a well-managed building without an elevator.
